meta: Years of English classes and still afraid to speak in front of others? AI is a practice partner that never laughs at you. Pick real situations, fix one mistake at a time, ten minutes a day.

muc.title: Afraid to speak English
muc.text: Many people study English for years but are still afraid to speak in case they make mistakes in front of others, and AI is a practice partner that never laughs at you.

muc.title: Pick real situations
muc.text: Ask AI to role-play a situation you're about to face, like a job interview, ordering at a restaurant, or asking for directions on a trip.

muc.title: One correction per turn
muc.text: Tell AI to speak slowly, use simple words, and after each turn correct only the single most important mistake, so you don't get overwhelmed.

muc.title: Ten minutes a day
muc.text: Ten minutes a day works better than two hours at the weekend, and note down the sentences you keep getting wrong to review next time.

muc.title: A ten-minute interview
muc.text: Turn on your chatbot's voice mode, ask it to play a job interviewer in English, and talk for ten minutes.
